description: This file contains functions for duplicating elements within a graphical editing application, including deep copying, managing group IDs, handling special element types like frames and bound text, and ensuring proper duplication behavior. It exports functions for duplicating single elements and multiple elements with options for customization.

methods.name: duplicateElement
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a given element, assigns new IDs, updates timestamps, and manages group IDs for duplication, optionally randomizing seed values.

methods.name: duplicateElements
methods.description: Duplicates multiple elements based on provided options, handling grouping, frames, bound text, and other special cases, and returns duplicated elements along with mapping info.

methods.name: deepCopyElement
methods.description: Performs a deep clone of an ExcalidrawElement, copying plain objects and arrays while avoiding non-serializable objects.
